purpose: ORACLE_CONFLICT: certified charts the corpus grade cannot score honestly. The gate halts (exit 1) when one of them becomes exact, instead of taking the credit - the fix is an identity or certification review, not a stepfile edit. Built from data by `tools/corpus_grade.py conflicts --write`; see docs/TOOLS.md.

rules.catalog: certified count != the chart's Phoenix 1 catalog count (sources/p1-note-counts, matched by song, type and level) while the file already converts to the catalog count
rules.same_side: a video certifies two or more charts on one side (a result screen shows one total per side)
rules.twin: another block of the file has identical STEPSTYPE, NOTES, BPMS, STOPS, DELAYS, WARPS, FAKES and TICKCOUNTS (header inherited): byte-identical to the converter, e.g. HIDDEN / INFOBAR twins
